context: V1 — profiled for diffing against ATokenDispatcherV2 only.
purpose: V1 abstract dispatcher base. dispatch() is external virtual with onlyMinter + whenNotPaused; concrete dispatchers override dispatch() directly. No ReentrancyGuard, no hook, no template-method split.
diffVsV2: No ReentrancyGuard (V2 adds nonReentrant on dispatch).
No hook / onDispatch (V2 adds DefaultDispatchHook + setHook + post-dispatch hook call).
dispatch() is external virtual and overridden directly (V2 makes dispatch non-virtual, concrete logic in internal _dispatch).
setMinter has no event in both versions.

localFindings.description: V1 dispatch path is not reentrancy-guarded. The concrete V1 BalancerPooler performs a vault.unlock callback during dispatch with no guard. Relevant only if V1 remains deployed; V2 fixed this with nonReentrant.
localFindings.recommendation: If V1 stays live, model its dispatch as reentrancy-unguarded.

externalEntryPoints.notes: Overridden directly by concrete V1 dispatchers.

valueFlows: Abstract; concrete overrides move value. No hook notification.
invariants: dispatch only by _minter, only when not paused.
trustAssumptions: _minter is the trusted V1 NFTMinter; owner trusted.
